description: The Smelter's health answer (SMELTER.md § Health): seven members, each from what the Smelter holds, for it asks nothing of the gateway, its embedding provider or its vector database to answer. `status` is `ok` whenever it answers, and says what else is so in the members beside it.

kb.description: The DID of the knowledge base it serves: the one its settings name, which that knowledge base said it is before the Smelter reached its index.

stream.description: The state of its own stream of the record, one of client/connection-states.json's. Events are delivered to it while it is `open`.

following.description: How far it has followed the record. Its sweep is also `due` where its start's reconcile failed.

eventsProcessed.description: How many events it has applied since it started: events of the kinds that do something, and not refused. Neither an event taken as nothing nor the work of a reconcile or a rebuild is counted.

reconcile.description: How far the latest reconcile has got: the pass's `summary` when it is done, or its `error` when it failed.

index.description: What the Smelter holds its index to, and what this start did for that.

stamp.description: The model and the cut it makes an index by.

embedding.description: The embedding provider's kind and model.

madeAnew.description: Whether this start made the index again, as it does where the index stated another stamp, or none.
